text:
Maya (CSM): CoveHealth asked for a focused enablement — embeddings tuning + a hands-on workshop to finish onboarding. They flagged model drift concerns and a renewal conversation in 6 weeks. Can we schedule a 90–120m session next week?
Leo (Enablement Lead): I can do Tue/Wed afternoon PST. Prefer Wed 2pm for a longer lab.
Priya (SE): Wed 2pm PST works for me but need 1 hour preflight with their infra lead to test VPC access.
Jonah (Renewals): Good to align timing with their CSM check-in — I can join and capture renewal signals. Wed 2pm keeps the renewal timeline tidy.
Maya (CSM): Awesome. Ops-bot — can you create a tentative calendar and invite CoveHealth stakeholders + our enablement slot?
ops-bot: Created tentative event: "CoveHealth: Embeddings Tuning Workshop (tentative)" Wed 2026-03-25 14:00-16:00 PST. Calendar link: https://cal.redwood.ai/event/abc123 (please confirm).
Leo (Enablement Lead): Agenda suggestion — 10m intros, 20m health & data review, 40m hands-on tuning lab (colab + sandbox), 20m rollout checklist + next steps. Add a 30m follow-up office hours slot a week later.
Priya (SE): For the lab we need: sample dataset, model version pinned (we recommend rwd-7b-q4f16), and API key with test scope. Asking CoveHealth to provide sample payloads by EOD Fri.
Maya (CSM): Sent a convo to CoveHealth asking for payloads and infra contact. @Jonah can you surface any renewal risk notes ahead of call?
Jonah (Renewals): Shared renewal risk summary in the thread: they called out latency spikes and inference cost as concerns. We should include a short cost optimization checklist in the session.
Leo (Enablement Lead): Noted — will add a "cost-by-config" slide and quick batching demo.
Maya (CSM): If we get their payloads by Fri, Priya and I will do the preflight Mon morning. If not, we keep Wed but scale back lab to demo-only.
Priya (SE): Preflight checklist: VPC peering test, sample file upload, test key, model pin ready. Posting snippet for their infra team:
```
# test curl to validate test key & model
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-q4f16","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Maya (CSM): I'll ping CoveHealth now. Anyone object to Wed 2pm?
Leo (Enablement Lead): Go for it. :thumbsup:
Jonah (Renewals): I'll join.
Priya (SE): All good.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team — I'll update the calendar once CoveHealth confirms and post final agenda here.
